name: +1 Speed Plane Escape
desc:
👑 Welcome to +1 Speed Plane Escape! ✈️

⚡ Every step = +1 Speed
🚀 Increase your speed to fly farther and farther
💪 Train your speed and unlock powerful multipliers
🏁 Race against friends and other players
🔥 Rebirth to push your limits
🏆 Become the FASTEST PLANE on the server
🪐 Watch your flight… one mistake sends you back 😱

👍 If you're having fun, don't forget to like the game!
